The Green Wave, led by third-year head coach [[Mike Dunleavy Sr.]], played their home games at [[Devlin Fieldhouse]] in [[New Orleans|New Orleans, Louisiana]] as fifth-year members of the [[American Athletic Conference]]. They finished the season 4–27, 0–18 in [[2018–19 American Athletic Conference men's basketball season|AAC play]] to finish in 12th place. They lost in the first round of the [[2019 American Athletic Conference men's basketball tournament|AAC tournament]] to [[2018–19 Memphis Tigers men's basketball team|Memphis]]. On March 16, 2019, Tulane announced Dunleavy would not return for the 2019–20 season.{{Cite web|url=https://www.nola.com/tulane/2019/03/tulane-and-mike-dunleavy-sr-to-part-after-3-losing-seasons.html|title=Tulane and Mike Dunleavy Sr. to part after 3 losing seasons|last=Dabe|first=Christopher|date=2019-03-16|website=nola.com|language=en-US|access-date=2019-03-19}}{{Cite web|url=https://tulanegreenwave.com/news/2019/3/16/tulane-mens-basketball-announces-a-change-in-leadership.aspx|title=Tulane Men's Basketball Announces a Change in Leadership|last=Athletics|first=Tulane|date=2019-03-16|website=tulanegreenwave.com|language=en-US|access-date=2019-10-10}} He finished 24–69 in three seasons at Tulane. == Previous season == The [[2017–18 Tulane Green Wave men's basketball team|Green Wave]] 14–17, 5–13 in [[2017–18 American Athletic Conference men's basketball season|AAC play]] to finish in 10th place.
